data.title: S3L4 — Murakkab-e-Izaafi (Mudaaf-o-Mudaaf Ilaih 1): رَبٌّ ← رَبُّ الْمَشْرِقِ: Buniyadi Misaalein
data.caption: S3L4 — Murakkab-e-Izaafi (Mudaaf-o-Mudaaf Ilaih 1): رَبٌّ ← رَبُّ الْمَشْرِقِ: Buniyadi Misaalein
rows: Arsh ka Rabb / Jaza ka din

data.text: **Qaa'ida (Pages 85–88):** Jab ek ism ki nisbat doosre ism ki taraf ki jaye ('... ka / ... ki / ... ke'), toh usey **Murakkab-e-Izaafi** kehte hain. Pehle lafz (**Mudaaf**) par na `الْـ` aata hai aur na Tanween (sirf ek harkat `ـُ` hoti hai), aur doosre lafz (**Mudaaf Ilaih**) ke neeche hamesha **Zair (`ـِ / ـٍ`)** aati hai (`رَبُّ الْمَشْرِقِ` Mashriq ka Rabb).

Murakkab-e-Izaafi: Jab ek Isim ki nisbat doosre Isim ki taraf ki jaye (jaise 'Allah ka banda', 'Arsh ka Rabb'). Pehle lafz ko Mudaaf aur doosre ko Mudaaf-Ilaih kehte hain. Mudaaf par na Alif-Laam aata hai na Tanween, aur Mudaaf-Ilaih par aam tor par Zer (kasrah) aati hai. Iss sabaq mein Mudaaf laal rang mein hai.
رَبُّ — Rabb (Paalne Wala / Maalik)
Lafz 'Rabb' ki mukhtalif cheezon ki taraf nisbat (jaise Rabbul-Arsh, Rabbul-Mashriq).

translations.en: Lord of Aaron (peace be upon him)
Lord of Moses (peace be upon him)

data.text: يَوْمُ — Din (Mukhtalif Ayaam ki Nisbat)
Quran mein 'Yowm' ki nisbat mukhtalif waqiaat ki taraf (jaise Yowmul-Qiyamah, Yowmul-Jumu'ah).

translations.en: People of Salih (peace be upon him)

data.text: قَوْمُ aur آلُ — Qawm aur Khandan
Mukhtalif Anbiya ki aqwam aur aal ki nisbat (jaise Qawmu Loot, Aalu Ibrahim).

translations.en: People of Lot (peace be upon him)

Family of Aaron (peace be upon him)
Family of Lot (peace be upon him)

data.text: أَهْلُ — Wale / Ahbaab
Lafz 'Ahl' ki nisbat (jaise Ahluz-Zikr, Ahlul-Bait, Ahlul-Kitab).

Aam qaaida yeh hai ke Mudaaf-Ilaih par Zer (kasrah) aati hai. Lekin kuch asmaa (jaise ghair-Arabi naam: Ibrahim, Ya'qoob wagaira) par Zer ki jagah Zabar (fatha) rehta hai. Iss se ma'ani par koi farq nahi padta.
عَذَابُ aur دَارُ — Azab aur Ghar
Azab aur aakhirat ke thikane ki nisbat (jaise Azabul-Hareeq, Darul-Aakhirah).
مَثَلُ aur قَوْلُ — Misal aur Farman
Misal aur aqwaal ki nisbat (jaise Masalul-Hayat, Qawlu Rasool).

translations.en: Like the example of a donkey

data.text: غَيْرُ aur أَيُّ — Ghayr aur Ayyu
Ghayr aur sawaliya lafz Ayyu ki nisbat (jaise Ghayrul-Haq, Ayyu Shay-in).
خَلْقُ aur امْرَأَةُ — Takhleeq aur Aurat
Takhleeq aur mukhtalif hastiyon ki biwiyon ki nisbat (jaise Khalqu-Samawat, Imra-atu Fir'awn).

translations.en: Wife of Noah (peace be upon him)
Wife of Lot (peace be upon him)

data.text: ذُو aur ذِي — Malik / Ba-ikhtiyar
Lafz Zoo aur Zee (malik / saahib) ki nisbat (jaise Zul-Arsh, Zil-Jalal).

translations.en: The matter / command of the Hour

data.text: وَعْدُ aur مَتَاعُ — Waada aur Samaan
Allah ke waadon aur duniya ke samaan ki nisbat (jaise Wa'dullah, Mata'ul-Ghuroor).

translations.en: The enjoyment / goods of worldly life

data.text: عِنْدَ aur مَعَ — Paas aur Saath
Zuroof ki nisbat (jaise Indallah, Ma'ar-Rasool).

translations.en: Evil of darkness as it settles
